verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox or test mode for trying tasks without touching real data. Muse's own VM is an execution environment for its code, not a test copy separate from production. Pre-action approval cards, one-time card numbers and VM backups are related safety controls, but none of them is sandbox isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
